connection_condition: both are grounded in the trans table; the cash withdrawal value domain is the subset of transaction rows whose operation code is 'VYBER'
description: A cash withdrawal is a specific kind of transaction, so every cash withdrawal is a transaction while only some transactions are cash withdrawals.

connection_condition: the region of a district is carried as the district attribute A3, so each district belongs to exactly one region
description: A region is composed of the districts assigned to it; the 77 districts are partitioned into 8 regions.

connection_condition: trans.account_id references account.account_id and every transaction carries exactly one account identifier
description: An account is composed of the transactions recorded against it; a transaction has no meaning without the account it belongs to.

connection_condition: loan.account_id references account.account_id; 682 loans map onto 682 distinct accounts, so at most one loan exists per account in this data
description: A loan is granted on exactly one account and cannot be interpreted without it.

connection_condition: the link is indirect: it is mediated by the disposition record, which carries both client_id and account_id and the role held
description: A client holds accounts and an account may be shared by several clients, so the relationship is many-to-many and always resolved through the disposition record.

connection_condition: client.district_id references district.district_id and denotes the client's residence
description: A client lives in a district, which is one of the two independent roles a district plays in this schema.

connection_condition: account.district_id references district.district_id and denotes the branch where the account was opened
description: An account was opened at a branch in a district; this is the second, distinct role a district plays and it does not always coincide with the client residence district.

connection_condition: the value is carried as the district attribute A11 and is therefore only reachable through the district record
description: Average salary is a measured attribute of the district rather than a value derived from the clients living there.

connection_condition: disp.client_id references client.client_id and every disposition belongs to exactly one client
description: A disposition is granted to one client, which is how a client is attached to an account.

connection_condition: disp.account_id references account.account_id and an account may carry one owner and one disponent disposition
description: A disposition targets one account; accounts with two dispositions are exactly those carrying a disponent in addition to an owner.

connection_condition: numerator is the count or loan total of accounts satisfying the stated condition and denominator is the corresponding count or total over all accounts in scope
description: A percentage over accounts is derived from account-level counts or totals, for example the share of accounts whose loan is still running.

connection_condition: numerator is the count of clients satisfying the stated condition and denominator is the corresponding count over the client population in scope
description: A percentage over clients is derived from client-level counts, for example the share of male clients who requested weekly statements.
